text.tspan: What Happens When You Load a Page
Six steps, most of them finished before you notice the page was loading.
CSS the style, JS the behaviour
The status code in step 5 tells you which side has the problem:
200 OK · 404 the page does not exist · 500 the server broke
Steps 1, 2, 3 and 6 happen on the user's machine. Steps 4 and 5 happen somewhere you may never see.
